# Location Theme › Theme Type

> Choose a theme that supports what you know of that location’s nature. For a random theme, roll on the table above.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:starforged/location_theme/type` · 1d100

- [15] Chaotic (`oracles/location-theme/chaotic/`) — Reality is corrupted or warped in this place.
- [10] Fortified (`oracles/location-theme/fortified/`) — Enemies defend this place against intruders.
- [10] Haunted (`oracles/location-theme/haunted/`) — Restless spirits are bound to this place.
- [15] Infested (`oracles/location-theme/infested/`) — Foul creatures have overrun this place.
- [10] Inhabited (`oracles/location-theme/inhabited/`) — People have built a community in this place.
- [15] Mechanical (`oracles/location-theme/mechanical/`) — Machines and technology hold sway in this place.
- [15] Ruined (`oracles/location-theme/ruined/`) — Time, disaster, or war have ravaged this place.
- [10] Sacred (`oracles/location-theme/sacred/`) — Worshipers glorify strange powers in this place.
